name: open-source-contribution-wall
title: Open Source Contribution Wall
description: A community recognition board displaying GitHub stars, active PR contributors, and sponsorship tiers.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Medium
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Monospace
Color: Accent Only

## Rules

- Open Source Contribution Wall Interaction: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
